title: MONSTER V3 Step 4 — Failure Ownership Engine
scope: Control-plane-only failure ownership classifier. Every failure must be assigned to PRODUCT, VERIFIER, CI, DEPLOYMENT, EXTERNAL, or STALE before any patch. Repository mutations are fail-closed outside the classified owner's authorized scope.
status_semantics: Anti-Loop V2 requires each changed PR task ledger to be replay-closed as DONE; Step-4 technical acceptance remains independently tracked below until proof is complete.
proof_policy: Exact PR-head and merged-main proof identity is owned by the Step-3 Truth Ledger and live GitHub evidence, not static task-ledger booleans.
